=== functions | -g
	.text
	.globl f
	.type f, @function
f:
	pushq %rbp
	popq %rbp
	ret
	.size f, .-f
	.type g, @function
g:
	ret
	.size g, .-g
	.type h, @function
h:
	ret
	.type d, @object
d:
	.byte 1
	.size d, 1
=== functions in DWARF 5 | --gdwarf-5
	.text
	.globl f
	.type f, @function
f:
	ret
	.size f, .-f
	.section .text.b,"ax",@progbits
	.type g, @function
g:
	nop
	ret
	.size g, .-g
=== ranges in DWARF 3 | --gdwarf-3
	.text
	nop
	.section .text.b,"ax",@progbits
	nop
	.section .text.c,"ax",@progbits
	ret
=== ranges in DWARF 4 | --gdwarf-4
	.text
	nop
	.section .text.b,"ax",@progbits
	nop
=== a macro in a repeat | -g
	.macro two a
	movl $\a, %eax
	movl $\a, %ebx
	.endm
	.text
	.rept 2
	two 1

	two 2
	.endr
	ret
=== a repeat in a macro | -g
	.macro m
	.rept 2
	nop
	pushq %rax
	.endr
	.endm
	.text
	m
	ret
=== instructions of any size | -g
	.text
	movabsq $0x1122334455667788, %rax
	jmp 1f
	.skip 200
1:	ret
=== a source file name | -g
	.file "hello.c"
	.text
	ret
=== a C file name in DWARF 5 | --gdwarf-5
	.file "hello.c"
	.text
	ret
=== a unit of its own
	.file 1 "a.c"
	.text
	.loc 1 1
	ret
	.section .debug_info,"",@progbits
	.long 0
=== data only
	.data
	.long 1
	.section .debug_info,"",@progbits
	.long 0
=== sections of data and code | -g
	.data
	.long 1
	.text
	ret
	.section .rodata
	.long 2
	.text
	nop
